page.title: Notifications

page.emptyBody: New feedback activity will show up here.

settings.title: Notification preferences
settings.description: Choose which in-app notifications you receive. Turned-off types stay visible in the list above.

created.label: New feedback
created.description: Notify me when new feedback is submitted

assigned.label: Assigned to me
assigned.description: Notify me when a feedback item is assigned to me

statusChanged.label: Status changes
statusChanged.description: Notify me when a feedback item I own changes status

comment.label: New comments
comment.description: Notify me when feedback receives a new comment

dnd.title: Do not disturb
dnd.description: While enabled, in-app notifications are muted during any of the windows below (they may cross midnight). Email subscriptions are not affected.
dnd.sameTimeError: Start and end cannot be the same
dnd.emptySlotsHint: Add at least one window for quiet hours to take effect

mutedProjects.title: Muted projects
mutedProjects.description: In-app notifications from muted projects are skipped. You can unmute at any time. Email subscriptions are not affected.
mutedProjects.empty: No projects in this organization yet

clear.title: Clear all notifications
clear.body: This deletes all {{count}} notifications (read and unread). This can't be undone.
